scope: Compile/final-link fixtures only; neither ELF is executed. No process ABI is frozen.

common.probe: Owned 64 MiB zero-initialized arena; checked absolute alignment, atomic bump, null on exhaustion; deallocation retains storage; default realloc allocates/copies
common.guest_obligation: M3 address-space-owned heap/quota, mapping and zeroing, fallible admission, OOM/panic termination and diagnostics; sustained allocation/reclaim tests

common.probe: Static ELF64 at 0x400000, distinct RX/R/RW segments, embedded immutable font bytes and BSS arena; no loader or stack setup
common.guest_obligation: M3 user ELF loader, checked mappings, guarded correctly aligned SysV stack, startup/termination, image lifetime and quota accounting

common.probe: Rust core/alloc/compiler_builtins plus pinned libm and portable text dependencies; final symbols and disassembly audited separately
common.guest_obligation: M3 establish user FP/SIMD enablement, initial state, save/restore and exception policy before UI execution; preserve M1 kernel exclusion; review actual instruction set/CPU dispatch and baseline CPU support

common.probe: Six exact P2-04 fonts embedded read-only; Engine verifies allowlisted hashes; same shaping, bidi, raster and cache APIs
common.guest_obligation: M4 immutable font resources, bounded package/handle lifetimes and parser failure isolation; native IME/coverage remain separate

common.probe: One synthetic text event with caller-supplied time/seed, shared Controller and typed executor; no physical input
common.guest_obligation: M3 trusted caller/session enforcement; M4 device input, translation, ordering/reset, focus/capture and real event dispatch

common.probe: Shared Scene semantic observations and stable IDs only
common.guest_obligation: M4 semantic export and action routing; native assistive consumer remains a later gate

common.probe: Owned RAM surface acquire/write/commit/release plus observable checksum; no device hook is declared successful
common.guest_obligation: M4 brokered surface/damage/lease transport, compositor/display ownership, wait and release; actual guest raster/presentation acceptance

common.probe: Unavailable; no filesystem, network, entropy, clipboard, IME, URL opening or native accessibility service
common.guest_obligation: Implement explicit scoped services when required; no std/host backend fallback

common.probe: Rust panic/OOM reaches terminal spin, never a success return; ELF is not run
common.guest_obligation: M3 bounded process failure/reaping and diagnostics; panic=abort alone is not a supervisor

custom.probe: Selected retained damage/raster and bounded layout cache are synchronous; Controller receives explicit timestamp; no clock read or wait implementation
custom.guest_obligation: M4 monotonic timestamp and frame/input opportunities, wake/sleep/pacing and bounded callback execution

custom.probe: Single synchronous call with exclusive mutable model/scene/surface references
custom.guest_obligation: M3 process/thread ownership and retirement; no IRQ rendering or concurrent mutation

slint_aot.probe: Same no_std slint-ui AOT Rectangle/Image/TouchArea component and Builder as hosted candidate; MinimalSoftwareWindow draws to owned RGB scratch then common RGBA
slint_aot.guest_obligation: M4 actual window/surface and input integration; present common software pixels, not toolkit compositor authority

slint_aot.probe: Platform.duration_since_start reads explicit Cell<u64>; advance_to rejects backward time, window construction advances one synthetic millisecond; timers updated synchronously, cursor flashing disabled; default click interval 500 ms
slint_aot.guest_obligation: M4 replace deterministic fixture time with monotonic service and wake/deadline scheduling; no wall-time or timer-accuracy claim

slint_aot.probe: Platform default run_event_loop/process_events returns NoEventLoopProvider; event-loop proxy None; no threads, spawn_local, cross-thread invocation or interpreter live preview
slint_aot.guest_obligation: M3/M4 one owning execution thread, authenticated input/event queue and wait; implement proxy/futures only with their own tests

slint_aot.probe: unsafe-single-threaded enables Slint no_std global context; Runtime installs platform once; subsequent installation is an error
slint_aot.guest_obligation: M3 enforce one execution thread for all Slint access, no IRQ/preemptive concurrent entry; preserve context/callback/resource lifetime and safe process retirement

slint_aot.probe: Native fonts not registered; common shaped text arrives as premultiplied Image items. Default clipboard setter no-ops/getter None, URL opening Unsupported, default no_std debug logging; bind_context does not retain context
slint_aot.guest_obligation: M4 integrate or explicitly reject missing platform functionality; do not credit defaults as working clipboard/logging/native text/semantics

slint_aot.probe: Pinned host slint-macros/compiler generate AOT Rust; target LLVM IR and final generated symbols/disassembly retained; no interpreter linked
slint_aot.guest_obligation: Preserve exact compile/runtime feature split; OS/API distribution terms and native feature gaps remain P2-08/P2-09 decisions
